paper.title: Combinatorial Reinforcement Learning with Preference Feedback

settings.name_in_paper: Episodic combinatorial MDP with MNL preference feedback, general function approximation for item-level Q-values
settings.out_of_scope_reason: Episodic MDP / reinforcement learning with state transitions (combinatorial RL), not a bandit problem.
unmapped: Episodic MDP with H steps per episode, K episodes; regret sums V*_1 - V^{pi_k}_1 over episodes
Assortments of at most M items always containing an outside option; user chooses one item via contextual MNL model with linear utilities phi(s,a)^T theta_h
Item-level Q-values approximated by a general function class satisfying completeness and realizability (including second-moment completeness)
Problem-dependent constant kappa lower-bounding MNL choice probability products
Learner knows the number of episodes K (used in nu and u_k)
Algorithm uses a consistent bonus oracle
settings.definition_quote: we consider a episodic combinatorial Markov decision processes (MDPs) with preference feedback ... Our goal is to minimize the cumulative regret over K episodes Regret(M,K) := sum_{k=1}^K V_1^*(s^k_1) - V_1^{pi_k}(s^k_1).

settings.name_in_paper: Linear MDPs with MNL preference feedback
unmapped: Linear MDP: transitions and rewards linear in known feature psi(s,a) in R^{d_lin}
Contextual MNL choice over assortments of at most M items with outside option
Learner knows the linear MDP feature map psi and dimension d_lin, and the number of episodes K
settings.definition_quote:
An MDP $\MDP$ is a linear MDP if we have a known feature mapping $\psi: \SetOfStates \times \SetOfGroundActions \rightarrow \RR^{\DimLinearMDP}$, and there exist $\DimLinearMDP$ unknown (signed) measures $\mub^\star_h = (\mu_h^{(1)}, \dots, \mu_h^{(\DimLinearMDP)})$ over $\SetOfStates$ and unknown vector $\wb^\star_h \in \RR^{\DimLinearMDP}$, such that for any $(s,a) \in \SetOfStates \times \SetOfGroundActions$, we have $\TransitionProbability_h(\cdot | s,a) = \langle \psi(s,a), \mub^\star_h(\cdot) \rangle$ and $r_h(s,a) = \langle \psi(s,a), \wb_h^\star
\rangle$.

settings.name_in_paper: Linear MDPs with MNL preference feedback (lower bound)
unmapped: Linear MDP with MNL preference feedback over assortments; lower bound via multi-layered linear MDP construction
settings.definition_quote: for any algorithm, there exists an episodic linear MDP with MNL preference feedback such that the worst-case expected regret is lower bounded

algorithms.name: MNL-VQL (MNL Preference Model with Variance-weighted Item-level Q-Learning)

bound.expression_latex: d\sqrt{HK}(\log K)^{3/2}\log M + \sqrt{d_\nu HK\log\frac{\mathcal{N}KH}{\delta}} + \frac{1}{\kappa}d^2H^2(\log K)^3(\log M)^2 + d_\nu H^5\log\frac{\mathcal{N}KH}{\delta}(\log\frac{\mathcal{N}\mathcal{N}_bKH}{\delta})^2 + \sqrt{\log\frac{\mathcal{N}\mathcal{N}_bKH}{\delta}}KH\epsilon_b

symbols.kappa: problem-dependent MNL constant (min product of choice prob and outside-option prob)
symbols.d_nu: average generalized Eluder dimension of F_h with nu = sqrt(1/KH)

conditions: Assumption 3.3 (completeness and realizability incl. second moment)
sum of rewards per episode in [0,1]
tuning: eta = O(log M), lambda = 84 sqrt(2) d eta

source.label: thm:regret_upper_general_app
source.quote: Suppose Assumptions~\ref{assum:MNL_click_model} and~\ref{assum:completeness} hold. ... Then, for any $\delta < 1/(H^2 + 15)$, with probability at least $1-\delta$, the regret of ~\AlgName{} is upper-bounded by: ... = O( d\sqrt{HK}(\log K)^{3/2}\log M + \sqrt{d_\nu HK \log\frac{\mathcal{N}KH}{\delta}} + \frac{1}{\kappa}d^2H^2(\log K)^3(\log M)^2 ) + O( d_\nu H^5 ... )

results.notes: Formal restatement of informal Theorem 5.1. Episodic RL setting (out of scope). Computational efficiency requires the bonus oracle (online sensitivity sub-sampling) and LP-based assortment optimisation.

symbols.d_lin: feature dimension of the linear MDP

conditions: linear MDP with ||psi||<=1, measures and reward params norm <= sqrt(d_lin)
tuning: u_k = Theta~((d_lin^3 H^{5/2} + d d_lin^{3/2} H^{5/2})/sqrt(K))

source.label: thm:regret_upper_linear_full
source.quote: Then, with probability at least $1-\delta$, the cumulative regret of \AlgName{}, with bonus oracle defined in Lemma~\ref{lemma:bonus_oracle_linearMDP}, is upper-bounded by Regret = \BigOTilde( d \sqrt{H K} + \frac{1}{\kappa} d^2 H^2 + d^{lin} \sqrt{HK} + (d^{lin})^6 H^5 ).

symbols.d_lin: feature dimension of the linear MDP

source.label: thm:regret_lower_linear
source.quote: Suppose that $d \geq 2$, $\DimLinearMDP \geq 6$, $H \geq 3$, and $K \geq \max\{ C\cdot (\DimLinearMDP -5)^2 H (H+1)^2, C' \cdot (d-1)^4 (1 + H) / H  \}$ ... Then, for any algorithm, there exists an episodic linear MDP with MNL preference feedback such that ... = \Omega( d \sqrt{HK} + \DimLinearMDP \sqrt{HK}).

results.notes: Restatement of Theorem 5.3. Expected regret E[sum_k V* - V^{pi_k}], i.e. through values.
